PG.rationale: PG presents a mildly attractive profile anchored by a high-quality franchise (29.7% ROE, 51% gross margins, $4B+ quarterly OCF, 70-year dividend streak) that has de-rated ~3 turns on P/E to 22.4x — the floor of its 1-year range. However, the fundamental trajectory is deteriorating: three consecutive quarters of declining EPS ($1.95→$1.78→$1.63), gross margin compression of -170bp QoQ to 49.5%, and a severe macro headwind from oil at $104.66 (+67.4%) that management quantifies as up to $1B annualized in FY2027. The earnings yield of 4.5% now merely matches the 10-year Treasury at 4.47%, eliminating the traditional defensive premium. The Q3 FY2026 results showed encouraging 3% organic growth with 2% volume gains, and the restructuring (7,000 job cuts) plus innovation pipeline (Tide evo, double-digit growth in innovated segments) provide structural offsets. But the May 13 earnings event showed flat organic sales and -1% volume decline, tempering the recovery narrative. The de-rating is largely rational given the input-cost and rate environment, not an overshoot. Score reflects a durable franchise at a fair-to-slightly-cheap valuation offset by a genuinely challenging near-term operating environment.

Earnings yield 4.5% now matches 10-year Treasury yield 4.47%, eliminating defensive premium; rising rates compress high-multiple defensives

Franchise remains robust: 29.7% ROE, #1/#2 market share in most categories, 70-year dividend streak, $10B dividends + $5B buybacks targeted for FY2026
Q3 FY2026 showed broad-based organic growth of 3% across all five segments with volumes up 2%, driven by innovation (Tide evo, Tide original liquid upgrade)
May 13, 2026 earnings event showed flat organic sales and -1% volume decline, stock fell 1.9% — volume recovery narrative weakened
Restructuring plan to cut 7,000 non-manufacturing jobs (~15% of that workforce) by mid-2027 should structurally lower cost base
Operating cash flow remains strong at $4.04B in Q3 (19.0% of revenue, OCF/NI=102%), supporting uninterrupted capital returns
